data.one_liner: Official authentication library and middleware for the Dart Frog backend server framework.
data.what_it_does: Provides the foundation for authentication on a Dart Frog backend server, supporting header-based authorization and cookie authentication.
use_when: You are building a backend server using the Dart Frog framework
You need to handle header authorization or cookie authentication in Dart Frog
avoid_when: You are writing a client-side Flutter application that needs to authenticate with social logins
You are using a backend framework other than Dart Frog
strengths: Official authentication library for Dart Frog
Supports both header-based and cookie authentication
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Dart Frog backend framework ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your Dart Frog project and configure authentication middleware according to the official documentation.
